papers.title: The Unknown Process Osseointegration.
papers.abstract: Although it was already described more than fifty years ago, there is yet no in-depth knowledge regarding the process of osseointegration as far as its mechanism of action is concerned. It could be one of the body's ways of reacting to a foreign body, where the individual's immune response capacity is involved. It is known that the nervous system has an impact on bone health and that the role of the autonomic nervous system in bone remodeling is an attractive field for current research. In the future, immuno/neuromodulatory techniques will open new and exciting lines of research.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅讨论骨整合的生物机制，未涉及任何生物制造、力学测试或植入物设计内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a biological review on osseointegration mechanisms with no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no porous structure, and no implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 骨整合机制尚未完全阐明，探索免疫和神经系统的调节作用。
summary_zh.method: 综述文献总结骨整合相关的免疫和神经因素。
summary_zh.result: 指出免疫/神经调节技术是未来研究方向。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To provide an overview of the unknown mechanisms of osseointegration, focusing on immune and neural involvement.
summary_en.method: A narrative review synthesizing existing literature on the role of the immune and autonomic nervous systems in osseointegration.
summary_en.result: Future immuno/neuromodulatory strategies are identified as promising for understanding and enhancing osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; purely a literature review.
